_doc: Maintained candidate universe for screen-first discovery (Phase 6 of docs/VALIDATION_FLYWHEEL_PLAN.md). discovery_screen.py runs the hard-gate cascade (slot-fit -> stage -> jurisdiction -> mcap -> survival -> REP-floor coverage) over these candidates; @scout enriches the SURVIVORS by web search instead of discovering from vibes. Grow this file from scout runs, exchange/sector lists, and peer-set members; every entry carries provenance + as_of (staleness-dated like everything else). Numeric fields are best-effort screen inputs, NOT valuation inputs — graduation (Phase 7) requires @verifier/@anti-scout to source them properly.

schema.name: company name
schema.slots: list of thesis-slot tags this candidate plausibly fits (silver-spear | gold-royalty-ballast | project-generator-holdco | electrification-royalty), or ["NONE"]
schema.vehicle: explorer | developer | operator | royalty | streamer | physical | holdco | project_generator | royalty_generator
schema.stage: grassroots | exploration | delineation | pre_pea | pea | pfs | dfs | permitting | construction | producer
schema.fraser_index: Fraser Investment Attractiveness of the primary asset's jurisdiction (number)
schema.stressed_in_ground_cad_m: in-ground resource at a stressed per-oz value, CAD millions
schema.as_of: YYYY-MM-DD the screen inputs were sourced
schema.last_review: YYYY-MM-DD of the last scout/operator review
